import { assign, enqueueActions, setup } from "../../../src/index.js"

/** A setup without agents keeps its existing contextual typing. */
const s = setup({})
/** The root assign form remains accepted without agents. */
export const assigned = s.createMachine({ initial: "x", entry: assign({}), states: { x: { after: { 1: "done" } }, done: { type: "final" } } })
/** The root destructuring form remains accepted without agents. */
export const destructured = s.createMachine({ initial: "x", entry: ({ event }) => void event, states: { x: { after: { 1: "done" } }, done: { type: "final" } } })
/** The context factory form remains accepted without agents. */
export const factory = s.createMachine({ initial: "x", context: ({ input }) => ({ input }), states: { x: { after: { 1: "done" } }, done: { type: "final" } } })
/** The enqueue form remains accepted without agents. */
export const enqueued = s.createMachine({ initial: "x", entry: enqueueActions(({ enqueue }) => void enqueue), states: { x: { after: { 1: "done" } }, done: { type: "final" } } })
